prometheus:
groups:
  - name: payments
    interval: 1m
    rules:
      - alert: HighErrorRate
        expr: rate(errors_total[5m]) > 0.5
        labels:
          team: pay
          severity: page
        annotations:
          summary: "{{ $labels.instance }} errors at {{ $value }}"
      - record: job:errors:rate5m
        expr: sum by (job) (rate(errors_total[5m]))
        labels:
          team: pay
